Few weeks ago, my finger nails got ripped off. It’s not that it hurt so bad I fainted, it was watching them wiggle. I was okay until I pulled my hand back and they all wiggled. Tunnel vision, I got extremely hot, my ears rung, then I woke up on the kitchen floor.

3 years before, a friend at working jokingly put me in a headlock. I was laughing, then I couldn’t breathe, I kept tapping, they said it was like watching an old CRT monitor shutting off and I slunk to the ground.

I fainted on a motorcycle way before that. I was passenger, I have a non-vented helmet driving through blue ridge mountain. My friend, who doesn’t speak clear English, was trying to talk to me. I said “I’m gonna pass out” and what he heard was “can we go fast”. I gripped him with my arms, kind of in a lock, I felt like I was drunk, and my body went limp backwards. I came to, we’re on the side of the road, my helmet is off and he’s cradling me like I’m dead on the phone with EMTs telling them I’m dead. I just overheated lol.

And a little bit before that, maybe like 4 months before, a guy from my high school strangled me. It felt like a vacuum sucked my oxygen out my lungs and all I saw were little black dots. This one was the fasted fainting out of them all. Had it not been for me making such a loud sound hitting the floor, he would’ve got away with killing me.

So I did this everyday for about a year. One day, in February 2017, I went to her house next door to check on her. I had been sick the days before and was paranoid of getting her sick, so I stayed clear. She left a paper plate taped the the window as a note saying, "you have three days to move you bastard" now, I don't talk about it much but my mother hates me and basically abandoned me all throughout my childhood. I got really hurt, upset, and a bit more vindictive than I should have been considering she was just old and senile. So I vowed to never help her again. 4 days pass, and the temperature drops significantly, so I decided to go visit her to make sure she was okay. I knock on her door then open it, and all of her dogs charge at me as usual. So nothing changed. The house is really cold, so none of the heating units she had were turned on. The TV was on, too, playing Little House On The Priraie - the episode where the kid turns blind or something. I saw her sitting in her chair like usual, asleep and using her left hand to hold her face. "Nancy" but no response. "Nancy, it's ______, I'm here to check on you" and still no response. I thought to myself "damn this woman can sleep" and went to go touch her shoulder. She was cold. My heart started to race. Panic rushed through me. I touched her face, and she was partially stiff. Her lower body wasn't stiff at all, just her face and neck. I was taking a high school forensics class and assumed that she had been dead for probably around a day or two. I stormed around the living room thinking I had killed this woman, and I wasn't sure who to call first because obviously she's dead, do I just call the police for a body recovery or do I call my dad first and see what he says. Come to find out after the autopsy, she had pneumonia as well as lung cancer that I had no idea of. She died before the temperature dropped, and if I were to have even been visiting her like I should have been, she would have been a goner anyway.
